name: aah, monster!
description: Agent entrypoint for the Aah, Monster! personal branding consultancy. Lets external AI agents discover the product catalog, initiate purchases over HTTP 402, and retrieve paid deliverables machine-readably.

checkout.protocol: POST /api/agent/buy -> HTTP 402 Payment Required with payment instructions, or HTTP 200 with a pre-filled Stripe hosted checkout URL

guardrails.rate_limit: max 3 buy attempts per agent_id+IP per 10 minutes (HTTP 429)
guardrails.currency_note: Product prices are fixed in EUR; the USD cap applies to programmatic (x402/zeroclick) settlement value per UTC day.
